sources_read: .qc-cache/hireops-workspace-2026-10-03-r9/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (openpyxl read_only; 'Quality Checks' row #16 and 'Internal Quality Checks' row #16: 'C - environment/ (assets & agent image) | environment_does_not_leak_the_answer | The agent's world has the inputs and the ask, but no finished copy of the deliverable.' Internal sheet carries no extra annotation in column E; zip has no comments part. Deterministic sheet related row check-instruction-hygiene.py also read.)
evidence: Procedure per quality-checks.md:70-71 (/app holds only .gitkeep; no starter/skeleton/schema/route list/partial UI in agent image; nothing under /instructions reproduces criterion text). (1) Agent image: task/environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the frozen template Dockerfile (diff empty; sha256 0a75419e...67d1 for both in manifest inputs). Its only COPY lines are 'COPY instructions/ /instructions/' and 'COPY assets/ /assets/'; /app is created by 'mkdir -p /app', git-initialised, and receives only 'touch /app/.gitkeep' committed as 'Initialize task workspace'. No COPY of solution/ or tests/; build context environment/ contains only Dockerfile, assets/seed_data.json, instructions/hireops_rules.md, instructions/integration.md (ls -la shows no hidden files). task.toml [environment] sets no docker_image, so no prebuilt image can inject content. (2) Assets: environment/assets/seed_data.json (sha a1c65c80...3740, matches manifest) holds only input records: generated_note, stages, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size, 10 users, 3 jobs, 16 applications (fields id/job_id/candidate_name/candidate_email/source/stage/position/rejected_from/reject_reason), 127 messages, 3 notes, 6 read markers (read_count). No HTML/JS, no schema/DDL, no route list, no precomputed derived outputs (no unread totals, no versions, no expected activity lines). grep for expected|rubric|criteri|judge|golden|solution|<html|function|require(|create table|unread_count|version found only a note body containing the word 'answers'. It is byte-identical to solution/app/src/seed_data.json, which is the expected copy of input data, not a deliverable. (3) Instructions: hireops_rules.md and integration.md are product rules and the runtime contract ('Routes, field names, element ids, button labels and the shape of the pages are yours' line 3-5; 'How routes and files are laid out under /app is up to you' integration.md:14) - no code, schema or UI skeleton. grep for judge|rubric|criteri|dimension|reward|weight|score|playwright|claude|glm|/tests|sentinel|probe|golden|oracle across instruction.md and both notes: zero hits. Word n-gram overlap scan against every tests/**/judge.toml and prompt.md: zero 12-word overlaps; at 8 words only two short requirement restatements in scored/functional/judge.toml ('...place the reason is shown and keyboard focus', 'arrive at the bottom of that stage in board order') - these are the public rule being graded, not criterion text or rubric structure leaking into the notes. Counterexample probes: a weak agent cannot pass by copying a finished app from the image because none exists (/app=.gitkeep only); a conforming agent is not disadvantaged since all inputs (seed, rules, accounts, runtime contract) are present. Static review only; no image was built/inspected at runtime (Docker not run by this reviewer), but the Dockerfile is the unchanged template so the static reading is decisive for this row.
